description: `->(x) { x }.call(1, 2)` raises ArgumentError (given 2, expected 1): lambda arity is *strict*. The arrow spine says exactly this -- one param -- so this is a rung a checker equipped with the arrow elimination rule should reject on its own, and no certificate should ever certify. Permanent negative target, and the honest half of the proc/lambda arity story.
